exercises.view: three-quarter side view showing bench contact and bar path
exercises.equipmentNotes: Flat bench and full barbell with both weight plates visible; feet planted, upper back and glutes supported, secure closed grip.
exercises.muscleNotes: Highlight pectoralis major in warm red, with subtle triceps and anterior deltoid involvement.

exercises.view: three-quarter side view showing hip depth and knee alignment
exercises.equipmentNotes: Full barbell rests securely across upper back, both hands grip the bar; both plates and both feet remain visible.
exercises.muscleNotes: Highlight quadriceps in warm red and gluteus maximus subtly; show neutral spine and knees aligned with toes.

exercises.view: three-quarter side view showing neutral spine and bar close to legs
exercises.equipmentNotes: Full barbell and both plates visible, plates touch floor at start; hands maintain closed grip, bar follows shins and thighs.
exercises.muscleNotes: Highlight posterior chain, spinal erectors, glutes and hamstrings; lock out standing tall without leaning backward.

exercises.view: front three-quarter view making forearm rotation and overhead finish visible
exercises.equipmentNotes: Seated on a bench with feet planted; one complete dumbbell in each hand, closed grips, stable wrists and controlled rotation.
exercises.muscleNotes: Highlight anterior deltoids in warm red with subtle lateral deltoid and triceps involvement; no exaggerated lower-back arch.

exercises.view: three-quarter side view clearly separating the opposite extended arm and leg
exercises.equipmentNotes: Bodyweight on a plain exercise mat; show supporting palm and opposite knee contact, all fingertips and toes visible.
exercises.muscleNotes: Highlight deep core and spinal stabilizers with subtle glute and shoulder stabilizer involvement; keep pelvis level and spine neutral.

exercises.view: three-quarter side view with enough headroom for the overhead jump
exercises.equipmentNotes: Bodyweight without equipment; use the no-push-up variant, palms planted during plank, feet visibly leave the ground during final jump.
exercises.muscleNotes: Show coordinated full-body effort with subtle leg, chest and core highlights; maintain aligned plank and controlled knee position.
